glossEn: choose and follow; as of theories, ideas, policies, strategies or plans
note: choose and follow; as of theories, ideas, policies, strategies or plans。主体是采纳者，宾语是理论/政策。The government adopted a new tax policy.

glossEn: take up and practice as one's own
note: take up and practice as one's own。把某做法变成自己的常规。会议正式通过决议也走这条（adopted by the council）。线索：宾语是 practice / resolution。
take into one's family。线索极强：宾语是孩子。They adopted a baby from the orphanage.
